topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: My New Room
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。请仔细阅读短文，根据短文内容选择或填写答案。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与短文中的单词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
passage: My name is Li Hua. I am a student. This is my new room. There is a bed in my room. There is a desk near the window. There are two chairs near the desk. There is a computer on the desk. There are some books on the shelf. The shelf is above the desk. There is a lamp on the desk. The lamp is next to the computer. There is a picture on the wall. The picture is above the bed. There is a cat under the bed. The cat is sleeping. My room is small but nice. I like my room.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，李华的房间里有什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中明确提到“There is a bed in my room.”，所以房间里有一张床。
questions.evidence: There is a bed in my room.

questions.prompt: 根据短文，书架上有什么？
questions.explanation: 短文中说“There are some books on the shelf.”，所以书架上有些书。
questions.evidence: There are some books on the shelf.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“There is a computer on the desk.”，所以电脑在桌子上。
questions.evidence: There is a computer on the desk.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“The lamp is next to the computer.”，所以台灯在电脑旁边。
questions.evidence: The lamp is next to the computer.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“The picture is above the bed.”，所以图片在床的上方。
questions.evidence: The picture is above the bed.

questions.explanation: 短文中说“There is a cat under the bed.”，所以猫在床下。
questions.evidence: There is a cat under the bed.

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空：There are two ______ near the desk. （请填一个单词）
questions.explanation: 短文中说“There are two chairs near the desk.”，所以填 chairs。
questions.evidence: There are two chairs near the desk.

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空：The cat is ______. （请填一个单词）
questions.explanation: 短文中说“The cat is sleeping.”，所以填 sleeping。

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 我们用“There is + 单数名词”表示“有一个……”，用“There are + 复数名词”表示“有一些……”。地点介词如 in, on, under, near, next to, above 用来表示位置。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是“be (am/is/are) + 动词-ing”。祈使句用来发出命令或请求，以动词原形开头。
grammar.example: There is a cat under the bed. The cat is sleeping.

options: There is a book on the desk.
There are a book on the desk.
There is two books on the desk.
answers: There is a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: 单数名词 book 前用 There is。
questions.evidence: There is a computer on the desk.

options: The cat is sleep under the bed.
The cat is sleeping under the bed.
The cat sleeping under the bed.
answers: The cat is sleeping under the bed.
questions.explanation: 现在进行时结构是 be + 动词-ing，所以用 is sleeping。

options: The lamp is next to the computer.
The lamp is next the computer.
The lamp is next to computer.
answers: The lamp is next to the computer.
questions.explanation: next to 是固定短语，后面要加名词短语 the computer。
questions.evidence: The lamp is next to the computer.

questions.explanation: 祈使句以动词原形开头，所以选 Open the door.
